title: Collinearity of Decomposed Energy Terms in MM-P(G)BSA Binding Free Energy Calculations of Protein-Protein Complexes
one_liner_zh: 该文评估MM-P(G)BSA方法在蛋白-蛋白复合物结合自由能计算中的精度，揭示分解能量项共线性问题，虽非TF-DNA体系，但方法学分析对蛋白-DNA互作结合自由能建模有借鉴意义。
abstract: The molecular mechanics (MM) Poisson-Boltzmann (PB) or generalized Born (GB) surface area methods (MM-P(G)BSA) are among the most commonly used end state approaches for the calculation of the binding free energies (BFEs) in computational drug design and screening studies. Their thermodynamic cycle is based on the decomposition of the free energy change into several energy terms, including molecular mechanics (MM) electrostatic and van der Waals terms representing the gas phase binding energy change, as well as implicit solvation energies comprising polar solvation, calculated by solving PB equation or its reduced form, GB, and nonpolar solvation surface area (SA) terms. Although these terms are additive, and thus the sum of these components should yield the total free energy change, most of these terms are represented with coefficients that are physically meaningful but empirical. To date, a great deal of effort has been made to improve the accuracy of these methods in the prediction of experimental binding free energies, at least relatively, i.e., relative binding free energy (RBFE), resulting in totally empirical coefficients on energy terms and breaking the underlying physics. Furthermore, although these methods originated from protein-ligand RBFE estimation, there have been examples or even tutorials using these methods for protein-peptide or protein-protein interactions (PPIs), due to the same simple physics of binding at the bound state, without sufficient hesitation regarding their accuracy limitations. Here, we thoroughly evaluate MMP(G)BSA methods in all variants available in the literature for a diverse protein-protein complex set and reveal their true RBFE accuracy by means of Pearson correlation with experimental values, with at most R = 0.42. We also demonstrate that the assumption of independent fitting coefficients for decomposed energy terms could not only break the physics but also statistically represent overfitting. Through analytic derivation and large-scale molecular dynamics simulations, we show that (i) the protein-ligand (PL), protein-peptide or protein-protein (PP) Coulomb interaction energy and the GB solvation correction are almost perfectly collinear (R 2 ≥0.99) reflecting their designed role as vacuum electrostatics plus solvent screening, and (ii) the van der Waals interaction and SA term also exhibit strong correlation. Interaction entropy (IE) and C2 entropy corrections, which are also found to be strongly dependent on each other, worsen the overall accuracy of the methods due to the large energetic fluctuations of these extended protein-protein systems. The findings of collinearity hold both at the level of instantaneous trajectory fluctuations and when averaged across a diverse set of 138 PP complexes and persist in both single-trajectory and three-trajectory MM-GBSA protocols. Our results show the limitation of the methods for protein-protein complexes and caution against using decomposed MM-GBSA terms as independent predictors in regression models and suggest instead combining correlated terms into effective polar, nonpolar, and entropic contributions, while noting the adverse impact of these entropy terms.
abstract_zh: 分子力学（MM）泊松-玻尔兹曼（PB）或广义玻恩（GB）表面积方法（MM-P(G)BSA）是计算药物设计和筛选研究中计算结合自由能（BFEs）最常用的末端状态方法之一。其热力学循环基于将自由能变化分解为多个能量项，包括代表气相结合能变化的分子力学（MM）静电项和范德华项，以及由求解PB方程或其简化形式GB计算的极性溶剂化、非极性溶剂化表面积（SA）项组成的隐式溶剂化能。尽管这些项是可加的，因此这些分量的总和应产生总自由能变化，但大多数这些项以物理上有意义但经验性的系数表示。迄今为止，已有大量努力致力于提高这些方法在预测实验结合自由能方面的准确性，至少是相对准确性，即相对结合自由能（RBFE），导致能量项上完全经验性的系数，并破坏了底层物理。此外，尽管这些方法起源于蛋白质-配体RBFE估计，但由于结合态下相同的简单物理原理，已有示例甚至教程将这些方法用于蛋白质-肽或蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs），而对其准确性限制没有充分犹豫。在此，我们全面评估了文献中所有变体的MMP(G)BSA方法，针对多样化的蛋白质-蛋白质复合物集，并通过与实验值的皮尔逊相关性揭示其真实RBFE准确性，最高R = 0.42。我们还证明，对分解能量项采用独立拟合系数的假设不仅可能破坏物理，而且在统计上代表过拟合。通过解析推导和大规模分子动力学模拟，我们表明：（i）蛋白质-配体（PL）、蛋白质-肽或蛋白质-蛋白质（PP）库仑相互作用能和GB溶剂化校正几乎完全共线（R² ≥ 0.99），反映了它们作为真空静电加溶剂屏蔽的设计角色；（ii）范德华相互作用和SA项也表现出强相关性。相互作用熵（IE）和C2熵校正，也被发现彼此强烈依赖，由于这些扩展蛋白质-蛋白质系统的大能量波动，恶化了方法的整体准确性。共线性发现既在瞬时轨迹波动水平上成立，也在跨138个PP复合物多样化集平均时成立，并在单轨迹和三轨迹MM-GBSA协议中持续存在。我们的结果显示了这些方法对蛋白质-蛋白质复合物的局限性，并警告不要将分解的MM-GBSA项用作回归模型中的独立预测因子，而是建议将相关项组合成有效的极性、非极性和熵贡献，同时指出这些熵项的不利影响。
